---
title: "NYC Restaurant Inspections Dashboard"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
    source_code: embed
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(p8105.datasets)
```

```{r}
data("rest_inspec")
```

```{r}
nyc_restaurants =
  rest_inspec |>
  select(
    camis, dba, boro, cuisine_description,
    inspection_date, score, grade,
    grade_date, latitude, longitude
  ) |>
  filter(
    boro %in% c("Manhattan", "Brooklyn", "Queens",
                "Bronx", "Staten Island"),
    grade %in% c("A", "B", "C")
  ) |>
  distinct()
```

Column {data-width=650}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Inspection Grades by Borough

```{r}
nyc_restaurants |>
  distinct(camis, inspection_date, grade, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  count(boro, grade) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~boro,
    y = ~n,
    color = ~grade,
    type = "bar",
    colors = c("#8E6BBE", "#F2C94C", "#E89AB3")
  ) |>
  layout(
    title = "Restaurant Inspection Grades Across NYC",
    xaxis = list(title = "Borough"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Number of Inspections"),
    barmode = "stack"
  )
```

### Inspection Scores Across NYC's Top 10 Cuisines

```{r}
nyc_restaurants |>
  filter(cuisine_description %in% c(
    "American", "Chinese", "Café/Coffee/Tea",
    "Pizza", "Italian", "Mexican",
    "Latin (Cuban, Dominican, Puerto Rican, South & Central American)",
    "Bakery", "Japanese", "Caribbean"
  )) |>
  distinct(camis, inspection_date, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    cuisine_description = recode(
      cuisine_description,
      "Latin (Cuban, Dominican, Puerto Rican, South & Central American)" = "Latin American"
    )
  ) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~cuisine_description,
    y = ~score,
    color = ~cuisine_description,
    type = "box",
    colors = "Set3"
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Cuisine"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Inspection Score"),
    showlegend = FALSE
  )
```


Column {data-width=350}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Geographic Distribution of Restaurant Inspection Scores

```{r}
restaurant_locations =
  nyc_restaurants |>
  filter(
    !is.na(latitude),
    !is.na(longitude),
    latitude != 0,
    longitude != 0,
    !is.na(score)
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(inspection_date)) |>
  distinct(camis, .keep_all = TRUE)

restaurant_locations |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~longitude,
    y = ~latitude,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "markers",
    color = ~score,
    colors = colorRamp(c("#F2A7C3", "#9B72CF", "#4B1D78")),
    text = ~dba,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Longitude"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Latitude")
  )
```


### Critical Health Violations Over Time

```{r}
critical_by_month =
  rest_inspec |>
  filter(
    critical_flag %in% c("Y", "N"),
    lubridate::year(inspection_date) >= 2016
  ) |>
  mutate(
    month = lubridate::floor_date(inspection_date, "month")
  ) |>
  group_by(month) |>
  summarize(
    percent_critical = mean(critical_flag == "Y") * 100
  )

critical_by_month |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~month,
    y = ~percent_critical,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "lines",
    color = I("#8E6BBE")
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Month"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Percentage of Critical Violations (%)")
  )
```
